assets.purpose: 开发者先倾听用户的工作问题，再决定产品怎样改变。
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: commissioned editorial artwork for a long-form practical guide to building products for overseas users. Landscape 16:9.
Visual direction: sophisticated contemporary print editorial illustration. Bold, flat, deliberately shaped silhouettes and crisp hand-cut color planes; economical fine ink details only where necessary. Warm near-white paper ground, deep ink navy, saturated cobalt blue, persimmon orange, and a little pale sand. Matte flat ink, extremely subtle print texture within colors only. A thoughtful grown-up magazine drawing, not a cartoon tutorial or stock corporate illustration. Strong asymmetrical composition, about a quarter open breathing space. Distinct readable shapes at 390px wide.
Avoid: manga eyes, portrait rendering, realistic skin shading, hair strands, glossy lighting, gradients, 3D, clay, watercolor, brown vintage paper, thick black outlines, decorative plants and cups, piles of paper, floating hands, tiny UI, ornamental symbols, globes, rockets, flags. No words, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks or fake handwritten text. Any documents use only a few broad abstract marks. Never imitate a screenshot, financial receipt, or observed evidence.
Scene: Listening before building. One adult maker in simplified side profile sits at the left edge of a spare narrow desk, pencil resting rather than writing, listening attentively. At right, a large clean rectangular video-call frame contains a second adult in equally spare silhouette, showing ONE client progress sheet and indicating a single orange problem area on it. The two figures' gaze and posture lead the eye toward this shared work problem. Heads are small, eyes indicated with a single minimal mark, no detailed faces. Use cobalt for the maker and frame, orange for the shared problem and one small clothing area. The document and act of listening are the focal point, not the hardware. Keep the people and task comfortably inside the image, with broad calm off-white space above; no oversized person cropped across most of the frame, no extra desk objects, no call toolbar.

refinement.input: first generated v3 draft, not published
refinement.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is the editorial illustration to correct. Keep the exact wide composition, two document boards, cobalt/orange/ivory palette, flat print texture, shapes and their sizes.
Remove the floating orange notched card in the CENTRAL GAP completely. Remove the dashed orange line from that gap completely. Fill both removed areas with the same uninterrupted plain ivory background.
Keep the original orange notched insert on the LEFT board. Keep the matching EMPTY pale notched cutout in the RIGHT board. The final picture contains exactly two boards and NO loose piece between them. It should show a difference between current work and an older incomplete copy, never suggest that the missing work is available to be restored. Do not add text, arrows, hands, symbols or new objects.
